faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Puntr is a community platform for sports fans to publish predictions before kick-off, then see each pick locked, automatically graded and kept in a public record. It gives your sporting knowledge a transparent track record.
faq.a2: PuntPoints are a loyalty scheme. You earn them for activity such as confirming your email, posting picks, settled picks and inviting friends, never for winning. You can redeem them for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks on the Rewards page. They have no cash value and cannot be bought.
faq.a3: Yes. Members get a personal invite link. When a friend joins and posts a first pick, you both earn PuntPoints after a short waiting period. Separately, if someone you refer becomes a paying Puntr Pro subscriber, you can earn recurring commission under the referral programme terms. See the Refer & earn page.
faq.a4: Yes. Puntr is free during the Founding 100 launch. Any paid features later will be announced first and never switched on without notice.
faq.a5: Every member’s record shows settled picks and performance context, including units, ROI and sample size. Past results are not a guide to future outcomes. Gamble responsibly: 0800 006 008.
faq.a6: No. PuntPoints have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for cash. You can only redeem them for the rewards on the Rewards page.
faq.a7: No. Puntr does not accept bets, set odds or hold betting funds. It helps members record, review and compare sports predictions.
faq.q8: How do I create a Puntr account?
faq.a8: Choose Sign up, provide the requested details and complete the email verification step. Use an email address you can access.
faq.a9: Puntr is intended for adults aged 18 and older. You must meet the age requirement and complete any required age attestation before using restricted features.
faq.q10: Why do I need to verify my email?
faq.a10: Email verification helps protect your account, confirms that you can receive important messages and may be required before some account actions are available.
faq.q11: I cannot log in. What should I do?
faq.a11: Check that you are using the email address linked to your account, retry the password reset process and make sure your browser allows the sign-in flow to complete. If the problem continues, contact support@puntr.co.za.
faq.q12: What is a pick or prediction?
faq.a12: A pick is your recorded prediction for a sporting event or market. Puntr time-stamps and locks it so your record reflects what you selected before the event began.
faq.q13: Can I edit or delete a pick after kick-off?
faq.a13: No. Picks lock at the relevant event's kick-off so records remain fair and auditable. Check the fixture, market and selection carefully before submitting.
faq.a14: A pick locks when the fixture reaches kick-off. This prevents selections being changed after the event has started.
faq.q15: What happens if a fixture is postponed or cancelled?
faq.a15: Puntr waits for the fixture status to be verified. A cancelled or abandoned event may be voided under the applicable grading rules; a postponed event is not automatically voided immediately.
faq.a16: Puntr aims to settle picks within minutes after a verified final result becomes available. Eligible fixtures are checked every five minutes for up to four hours after kick-off, then every fifteen minutes for older unresolved matches. The settlement process runs every two minutes. Provider delays or conflicting reports can still extend the wait.
faq.q17: Why is my pick or duel still awaiting settlement?
faq.a17: A fixture can remain pending when a result source has not published full time, sources disagree, or a provider is temporarily unavailable. Puntr will not guess a score. Priority checks retry automatically; if it remains unresolved for more than 60 minutes after full time, contact support with the fixture and pick or duel link.
faq.a18: It means the match has kicked off but Puntr has not yet accepted a final score under its verification rules. Your pick remains unchanged until a valid final result is confirmed.
faq.q19: Where do Puntr results come from?
faq.a19: Puntr checks competition and established sports information sources. A result is published when the official competition source confirms it or independent sources corroborate the same final result.
faq.q20: What if Puntr shows the wrong score?
faq.a20: Do not assume the pick has been graded correctly. Send support the fixture name, competition, displayed score and a link or screenshot. The team will review the source evidence and any correction will be recorded.
faq.q21: Can a match finish 0–0 and still be unsettled?
faq.a21: Yes. A 0–0 score alone does not prove that a match is over. Puntr also needs a verified full-time status before it can settle picks.
faq.a22: A void pick is one that is not graded as a win or loss under the applicable rules, for example where a fixture is cancelled or a market cannot be validly settled. Void picks carry zero units.
faq.q23: What are units, ROI and sample size?
faq.a23: Units show the net performance of settled picks using the recorded odds. ROI expresses performance relative to the relevant stake or exposure, and sample size shows how many picks support the record. Always consider all three rather than a short winning streak.
faq.q24: Does Puntr offer betting odds or accept bets?
faq.a24: No. Puntr does not take bets, hold betting funds or set bookmaker odds. Any odds recorded with a pick are performance context, not an offer to place a wager through Puntr.
faq.a25: Duels let two members compare their calls on the same fixture using the markets shown in the duel. Picks are hidden from the other participant until kick-off and are graded from the same verified fixture result used for ordinary picks.
faq.a26: Once the fixture has a verified final result, Puntr grades each participant's calls. The participant with more correct calls wins; a tie is recorded as a draw. If the fixture is void, the duel is voided under its rules.
faq.q27: Why is my duel still active after the match?
faq.a27: A duel remains active while the underlying fixture is not marked finished with a verified score. It will be retried by the settlement watchdog; contact support if it remains unresolved more than 60 minutes after full time.
faq.q28: What are AI profiles in Duels?
faq.a28: AI profiles are clearly labelled synthetic participants used for product interaction and practice-style competition. They are not real members, and their calls are evaluated against the same fixture result rules.
faq.q29: Can I challenge an AI profile?
faq.a29: If an AI challenge is available in the Duels area, you can participate using the markets and rules displayed there. The duel still depends on a verified final fixture result before it can settle.
faq.a30: Puntr does not accept cash stakes or wagers. Where a PuntPoints stake option is enabled, it uses platform loyalty points subject to the displayed rules and eligibility controls. PuntPoints have no cash value.
faq.a31: PuntPoints are platform loyalty points that may be earned through eligible activity and redeemed for rewards shown in the Rewards area. They are not money, cannot be withdrawn and cannot be bought.
faq.q32: Why have my PuntPoints not appeared yet?
faq.a32: Some rewards are credited only after an activity is verified or a waiting period has passed. Check the relevant activity or reward terms first; if the points are still missing, send support the date and activity details.
faq.q33: How do I redeem a reward?
faq.a33: Open Rewards, review the available reward and its eligibility or redemption conditions, then follow the instructions shown. Availability may vary by campaign and stock.
faq.q34: How does the referral programme work?
faq.a34: Use your personal referral link and share it with someone who is eligible to join. Referral rewards and any subscription commission are subject to the programme terms and the qualifying actions shown in your account.
faq.q35: When will a referral reward be credited?
faq.a35: A referral must complete the qualifying steps and any applicable verification or waiting period. A sign-up alone may not be enough. Check the referral page for the current status and conditions.
faq.a36: Puntr Pro is the platform's paid membership tier where offered. Its current price, benefits, billing period and cancellation terms are displayed on the upgrade or subscription screen before you subscribe.
faq.q37: How do I manage or cancel a subscription?
faq.a37: Use the subscription or billing controls shown in your account or the payment provider's customer portal. If you cannot find the controls, contact support before your next renewal date.
faq.a38: Practice Mode is a simulated environment for trying prediction features without placing a real-money bet. Any points, scores or outcomes in practice should not be treated as cash winnings.
faq.a39: Fantasy Arena is Puntr's planned fantasy-style sports competition experience. Its availability, scoring rules and launch updates will be announced in the product when ready.
faq.a40: Leaderboards use settled performance and the ranking rules displayed on the relevant page. Unsettled picks do not count as final results, and rankings can change as verified results are processed.
faq.q41: Why has my profile or leaderboard record not updated?
faq.a41: Some profile statistics refresh after settlement or a scheduled aggregation. Refresh the page after a short wait; if a settled pick is still missing, contact support with its link.
faq.a42: Badges recognise qualifying platform activity or milestones. Each badge may have its own eligibility rules, and progress can take time to update after an activity is verified.
faq.a43: Use the notification controls available in your account or device settings. Transactional or security messages may still be sent where necessary.
faq.a44: Some bookmaker links may be affiliate links. Puntr may receive a commission if you use them, but that does not change your pick record or the result verification rules. Always review the bookmaker's own terms.
faq.a45: Only information that Puntr displays on public profiles, picks, leaderboards or other public features is visible to other users. Do not include sensitive personal information in public profile fields or duel messages.
faq.q46: How do I report a bug or suspicious activity?
faq.a46: Use the support form or email support@puntr.co.za. Include the page, fixture or feature involved, what you expected, what happened and the approximate time. Never send your password or one-time security code.
faq.q47: What should I do if the website is not loading?
faq.a47: Check your connection, refresh the page, try an updated browser and temporarily disable extensions that may block scripts. If the issue persists, send support the page URL, device/browser details and a screenshot.
faq.a48: Email support@puntr.co.za or use the contact form on the Support Centre. Include enough detail for the team to identify the account or fixture involved, but never send your password.
faq.a49: Puntr is a sports prediction and performance-tracking community, not a bookmaker. If you choose to use third-party betting services, do so legally and responsibly, set limits and seek help if gambling stops being recreational. South Africa's National Responsible Gambling Programme helpline is 0800 006 008.
